caption: A hairdryer is aimed at a long-haired wig on a stand, and the hair streams away from the nozzle.

sa.check: A long-haired wig sits on a stand.
A hairdryer is aimed at it.
The hair streams away from the nozzle.
The dryer is aimed first and the hair moves after.

pc.expect: The hair blows in the direction the dryer points.
pc.fail: It blows toward the nozzle; or sideways; or straight up when the dryer points across.

pc.expect: The hair moves only while the dryer is running and aimed, and falls back when the dryer moves away.
pc.fail: The hair streams with the dryer off; or stays streaming after the dryer moves away; or moves before the dryer is aimed.

pc.expect: The hair flows in strands and flutters.
pc.fail: It moves as a rigid block; or stretches; or detaches all at once.

pc.expect: When the airflow stops the hair falls back down.
pc.fail: It stays up; or rises; or hangs out sideways.

pc.expect: One wig on one stand keeps its number.
pc.fail: The wig merges with the dryer; or the stand duplicates; or hair passes through the stand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wig's colour and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The hair changes colour; or the stand changes; or the background rearranges.
